rows.en: Mister Brain, the test was a failure! We needlessly let an excellent pilot die!
The test was a success, Hustler!
Exactly so, Mister Brain!
You!! Shut up, you bootlicker…

The Battleship Robot's pilot lost to One-Seven! In other words, because he was a Brain Party member.

Mister Brain, am I wrong?

Gomez, you are correct…

If we use a pilot that One-Seven cannot kill, the Battleship Robot can fight One-Seven as an equal… no, better than an equal!
Hmph! And where would you find a pilot like that?
Oh, there is one, Professor…
…What!?
So then, Rumi is…
Yes… I've contacted Chie, but this happened even with us right there…
Still… for Gigant to act like that?
What do you mean?

It may be a pure combat organic droid, but…

it shouldn't be possible for it to act of its own will!

And yet… they were clearly acting with a will. Even going so far as something like kidnapping…
So in other words… what, this Gigant thing has started acting like a human?

Did they introduce the Vol Cell system?

But… Vol Cells completely take over the host's eukaryotic cells…

Unless the Vol Cells themselves grow into an intelligent life form… there should be no thought in it at all! It's still hard to believe…

A pseudo-personality…!?

Did Atefarina the Battle Princess use Vol Cells to alter Gigant's thought routines?

It's not out of the question…

Only our Roaring Steel can protect the host's eukaryotic cells from the Vol Cells…

In other words… it can fuse with the Vol Cells while keeping the host's will intact…

They may have used a pseudo-personality in place of the host's thoughts! If so… that would be the ultimate bioweapon.
Yes… I've contacted Chie. But this happened with us right there…

I'll grant that it's an organic droid… but the earlier types never acted of their own will…

But… they were clearly acting with a will. Even going so far as something like kidnapping…
So in other words… what, this Gigant thing sized up the situation like a human?
Yes… Compared to the earlier types, it feels closer to an intelligent life form.
I sensed it too. I don't want to believe it, but Gigant's "heart"…

Maybe they've applied the Vol Cell system to Gigant?

This is bad… It's going to be harder to fight them from now on!
Rumi Sahara, how do you feel?
…Wonderful, Mister Brain.
Good, with this… Rumi Sahara is completely under our control! All that's left is to put her in the Battleship Robot…
Dr. Sahara! The Battleship Robot has appeared!
What!?
Father…
Chief Kitakura! Could you confirm who the Battleship Robot's pilot is?
Roger! The Security Unit is moving out at once!!
That pilot is…!? Just as I feared… Rumi?
…Dad!
Rumi…
One-Seven! Rumi is inside the Battleship Robot…
What should I do?
The Sigcon Jet…!? It's the scout plane stored inside One-Seven.
One-Seven… What on earth are you going to do?
Waaaagh, One-Seveeen!
…!? The Sigcon Jet…
…!? Rumiii!!
It's sleeping gas! One-Seven seems to have fired sleeping gas in with the Sigcon Jet!
Approaching the Battleship Robot now… I'll rescue Rumi!
I'm counting on you, Saburo…
Rumi! Hang in there!
Ugh…
This is Officer Minami… I've successfully rescued Rumi!
Gomez! What did you want to talk about?
Professor Hustler… Won't you join hands with me?
…Join hands?
Yes… The two of us will take control of Brain!
Are you insane!? Gomez?
If Brain says "NO", then we simply destroy Brain…

Have you forgotten, Gomez!

Brain's… super-regeneration ability, that revives it no matter how many times it's destroyed?

Brain's super-regeneration takes 10 seconds from destruction to rebuilding…

If we set off a second and third charge within those 10 seconds, Brain will vanish from the face of the earth! Am I wrong, Professor Hustler…
How do you intend to plant explosives on Brain?
The explosives are already planted!
What!?
Heh heh heh… What will it be, Professor Hustler?
Chief… Professor Hustler doesn't seem to believe it. Show him the way!
Sir…
This is directly beneath Brain…
Where are the explosives? There aren't any anywhere!
Just as you say, they're not here! I moved them somewhere else…
What do you mean?
Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha!
Yes! Mister Brain, I'm heading out!
Rumi! It's your sister, pull yourself together!
Please put her back to sleep…
Yes, sir…
Ahh, Mister… Brain…
Rumi's brainwaves are still being manipulated by Brain.
That's it, One-Seven! With One-Seven's computer, we might be able to win Rumi's brainwaves back from Brain.
One-Seven… The One-Seven that Brain built.
Father, let's ask One-Seven! Saburo, please!
Dr. Sahara… Why not leave it to Saburo?
Mm… Saburo, I'm counting on you!
Yes, sir!
Brain, I need to talk with you…

uncertain: U07462: [ja] — logic compressed in source; rendered literally ("because he was a Brain Party member", i.e. One-Seven could kill him).
U07471/U07477: 官機ドロイド read as 有機ドロイド ("organic droid"); 飩 read as 純 ("pure combat").
U07475: 轟合 read as 融合 ("fuse").
U07494: Saburo's question, addressed to himself/One-Seven.
U07512/U07513: 超生産能力 rendered "super-regeneration ability" (it rebuilds itself after destruction).
U07525: Rumi (brainwashed) talking in her sleep; translated as said.
